policies.description: Auth files require security agent review before modification
DB migration files require migration-reviewer agent review before modification
GitHub workflow files require devops agent review
Environment config files (.env, .env.*, *.env, and direnv .envrc / .envrc.*) require security agent review; the committed templates .env.example, .env.sample and .env.template are exempt

Git hooks run unsandboxed on the next commit/push (the repo's .githooks/ is the source install.sh deploys to ~/.claude/githooks, which core.hooksPath points at); edits require a security review this session
Git internals (.git/config, hooks, info, and a gitfile .git pointer) execute or steer unsandboxed git; file-tool edits require a security review this session
Credential files (credentials*, *credentials*.json) hold secrets; a file-tool write here is flagged for security review. Warn only: never blocks
Secrets files (secrets*, *.secrets*) hold secrets; a file-tool write here is flagged for security review. Warn only: never blocks
An auth/ directory outside src/auth/ (which auth-requires-security already blocks) holds authentication code; a file-tool write here is flagged for security review. Warn only: never blocks
Global git config (~/.gitconfig, ~/.config/git/) can define fsmonitor/hooksPath/filters that run unsandboxed for every repo
